# Generated files and native copies

- Editable owners: [configuration map](../README.md). Runtime derivations live in `scripts/state/generated/<component>/`; tests use their own run folders.

| Consumer | Editable source -> runtime behavior |
| --- | --- |
| Model IDs | `models/catalog.json` -> `models/ids.py` generated by `catalog.write_ids()` / `model_admin`; never edit the generated file |
| KoboldCpp | Native `.kcpps` + Python overrides -> direct config and CLI flags; browser launch disabled by default |
| AudioCpp standalone | `audiocpp/server.json` -> direct native config |
| Shared AudioCpp | Base JSON + shared policy -> `generated/audiocpp/shared-<port>.json` |
| External Kokoro | `KOKORO_TTS` -> `generated/audiocpp/kokoro-<port>.json`, CPU, one model |
| Pi/Lens | `../coding_agents/pi/` -> app-required agent settings/extensions; preserve user state |
| Strata | `strata/*.json` -> native settings shared with desktop/Pi; host/credential overrides at launch |
| ComfyUI | Owned YAML/workflows/node -> required installation copies during sync/startup |

- Tracked native configs write {AI_ROOT} instead of a machine path; [paths.py](../paths.py) resolves it on read and copies the result to generated/shared/configs/ for programs that need real paths.
- Recreate derived configs on launch; edit the owner source, never generated output.
- Native AudioCpp JSON owns model modes/session defaults. Python owns service selection, proxy/playback defaults and explicit shared overrides.
- ComfyUI sync changes owned files only; removed managed workflows are retired, missing source aborts. Preview/apply: `python -m scripts.config.sync`.
- Strata native app data and its compatibility junctions remain app-managed; [locations](../strata/README.md).
- Generated configs may contain local credentials; keep them outside Git and shared reports.
- Preserve saved historical configs/logs. Future paths derive from the canonical component map.
